Title: Azure SQL Database ledger available in public preview

Body.Content:
Ledger capability is now supported on SQL Database, enabling tamper-evidence through cryptographic verification for your centralized data stores. Ledger eliminates the additional cost, complexity, and performance overhead of decentralized blockchain technology while providing many of the benefits of blockchain in a fully managed and familiar SQL environment.

Learn more by reviewing our documentation and reading the Tech Community blog.
